why: Intro to the terminal plan (docs/ui-next/catalog/plans/intro-terminal.json), 'Write a shell script' (passes: running ./newday.sh makes a note named with today's date). The learner ran ./newday.sh before chmod: 'zsh: permission denied: ./newday.sh'. They then ran chmod +x newday.sh and ./newday.sh again, which printed 'Created notes/2026-11-24.txt', and `ls notes` lists the file. The permission error is from before the chmod: done.

step.title: Make it executable and run it
step.instructions: In trail-log, make newday.sh executable with chmod +x newday.sh, then run it with ./newday.sh. It makes a note in notes named with today's date, like 2026-11-24.txt.

targets.caption: Let the script run as a program

checks.label: The script runs without errors
checks.pattern: permission denied|command not found|no such file

files.trail-log/newday.sh:
#!/bin/zsh
# make today's note
today=$(date +%F)
touch notes/$today.txt
echo "Created notes/$today.txt"
